text:
Type: pair of linen curtains
Use: dressing windows, softening light and adding privacy; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, Japandi
Materials: semi-sheer washed linen with a slub texture, hidden tab top
Colors: dark charcoal grey
Shape: two long straight panels that hang in soft vertical folds from a rod, gathered tab-top heading, fine uneven weave, light and flowing
Feel: calm, natural, relaxed, soft
Goes with: light wood, white or grey walls, natural textiles, black accents; Scandinavian, Japandi or minimalist rooms

product.name: AINA
product.description: The curtains lower the general light level and provide privacy by preventing people outside from seeing directly into the room.
